title: Adding an in-product email storage cleanup
summary: The Payables Agent app adds an email storage cleanup page, reachable only via a URL parameter, that helps admins find duplicate email records and clean up email storage. A scheduler proactively sends admins steps for remediation.
key_points: New PA Email Storage Cleanup and PA Email Duplicates pages, accessible only via URL parameter
New cleanup setup table and duplicate buffer table
Cleanup, runner, inbox row delete and scheduler codeunits added
Scheduler proactively sends admins remediation steps
Payables Agent admin permission set updated for the new objects
quote: Adding an in-product solution (accesible only via URL parameter), to proactively send to admins steps for remediation.
